restaurantName: San Chieh Mei Nung Chia Le
address: 23 Daping Road, Wanli District, New Taipei, Taiwan
bio: Three sisters restored the family courtyard house, turning it into a restaurant with a retro farmhouse feel. The bubbly, friendly siblings serve dishes made using produce grown on their own farm. Comprising four to six dishes and soup, the set menus cover all the greatest hits in Taiwanese cooking, a particular stand-out being the sautéed vegetables with mashed taro. It's tucked away in the mountains and only accessible by car or taxi.
pageTitle: San Chieh Mei Nung Chia Le
